scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:ui & pnpm run docs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter resource-manager-ui run clean && pnpm --filter resource-manager-docs run clean
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter resource-manager-ui run lint && pnpm --filter resource-manager-docs run lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter resource-manager-ui run lint --fix && pnpm --filter resource-manager-docs run lint --fix
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter resource-manager-ui run type-check && pnpm --filter resource-manager-docs run type-check
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm publish --filter resource-manager-ui
scripts.release:dry: pnpm run build && pnpm publish --filter resource-manager-ui --dry-run
